description: The homing test: open the drawer, press the button, in the fixed scene of drawer_button_door. Without a home phase, and with 40 or 80 env steps guided towards spawn poses before the button. Same seed, 60 rollouts of up to 600 steps each, no video. In the spawn test the button worked in 49 of 60 from a spawn pose and 39 of 60 from where the drawer step left the arm. Run with dynaguide_scripts/run_homing_door_tests.bat
